paper.title: Decentralised convex optimisation with probability-proportional-to-size quantization

algorithm.name: PPS Primal-dual method (Algorithm 2)
citations: PDF pp.6-7, Section 2 and PPS equation (1)
PDF p.11, Algorithm 2 and coefficient conditions
assumptions: Three-dimensional smooth strongly convex primal quadratics and positive-definite diagonal affine A.
Exact zero-noise conjugate oracle and fixed supported PPS uniform draws; both sign masses stay positive.
Coefficient inequalities following Algorithm 2 hold with dual gradient Lipschitz bound L=1.
Finite algebraic validation only: quadratics do not satisfy the paper global uniform bounded-oracle hypothesis, so no probabilistic convergence theorem is asserted.
The decentralized Algorithm 3, barycenter specialization, and Algorithm 1 are outside the tested scope.

cases.purpose: Check signed PPS categorical quantization inside the accelerated primal-dual recursion, varying beta, and weighted primal restoration across initialization and three updates.

inputs.network: Algorithm 2 is the generic affine-constrained primal-dual method, evaluated centrally; no gossip matrix or decentralized Algorithm 3 is used.
inputs.primal_objective: f(x)=sum_j q_j*(x_j-c_j)^2/2 on R^3, subject to A*x=b; A=diag(A_diagonal).
inputs.conjugate: f_star(v)=sum_j(c_j*v_j+v_j^2/(2*q_j)); exact deterministic stochastic oracle F_star=f_star.
inputs.oracle: g(mu)=b-A*x(-A^T*mu)=b-A*c+diag(A_diagonal^2/q)*mu; r=1 at all calls, no xi noise.
inputs.initialization: mu0=[0,0,0]; draw PPS at mu0; lambda0=-alpha0/beta0*G0; A0=alpha0.
inputs.randomness: At each oracle call k=0,1,2,3 use the corresponding two uniforms for positive and negative signs. For weights max(g,0) and max(-g,0), choose smallest zero-based index whose normalized cumulative weight is strictly greater than u. Use all two draws with replacement separately per sign, and PPS=sum_positive_mass/2*counts_positive-sum_negative_mass/2*counts_negative. Both masses remain positive in these fixtures. No other randomness.
inputs.observations: step0 is initialization after the first PPS call and lambda0. step s=t+1 is after completing the t-th loop. z_used uses beta_t and weighted G0..Gt; mu, PPS_G, mu_hat, lambda correspond to subscript t+1; restored_primal_at_mu uses unquantized restoring function at mu_{t+1}; primal_average includes alpha0*x(-A^T*mu0) through alpha_{t+1}*x(-A^T*mu_{t+1}), divided by their sum. Residual and objective are evaluated at that average.
inputs.scope_limitation: This smooth quadratic fixture checks finite algebraic recurrences. Its dual gradient is bounded on the visited points, but not uniformly on all R^3; it therefore does not instantiate the global bounded-oracle hypothesis of Section 2 or validate the large-deviation theorems.

parameters.uniform_draw_interpretation: Exact decimals in [0,1); no PRNG seed semantics.
